name: ead-status-timeline
title: The usual order of EAD status messages
subtitle: Receipt-to-approval time depends on the category. The steps after approval usually take one to three weeks.

steps.label: Case Was Received
steps.detail: USCIS accepted the I-765 and assigned a receipt number.

steps.label: Case Is Being Actively Reviewed
steps.detail: In the queue. Not a sign that a decision is near.

steps.label: Case Was Approved
steps.detail: A decision, not a card. You cannot work on the approval message alone.

steps.label: Card Was Mailed To Me
steps.detail: USPS tracking appears in your USCIS account. Usually 3 to 10 days.

steps.label: Card Was Delivered To Me By The Post Office
steps.detail: Check every printed date and the category code.

source: USCIS Case Status Online messages for Form I-765, as described in the TrackMyOPT EAD status guide.
